about_short_description.short_description: Diffuse Bio develops an automated AI software platform for drug design, leveraging advances in generative AI.

product.name: DiffuseSandbox
product.description: A software environment for generating and evaluating AI-designed protein binders, enabling researchers to create candidate sequences for therapeutic and research applications.

product.name: RamaX Discovery
product.description: An experimental binder-screening workflow that evaluates large naive or AI-designed protein libraries against selected targets and identifies candidate binders for validation.

product.name: RamaX Opt
product.description: An experimental sequence-optimization workflow for improving protein-binder affinity while addressing objectives such as sequence-liability removal, humanization, and cross-species binding.

product.name: ProxyTm
product.description: A protein-thermostability measurement method for evaluating the thermal stability of proteins at scale.
